declarations.description:
A rich-text notepad that reads as a sheet of paper: handwriting on ruled lines, a margin, a spiral binding and
paper grain. Selecting text opens a formatting toolbar drawn as a strip of washi tape (bold, italic, underline,
strikethrough, and one button each for the four inks and the three highlighters). Lines written as `[ ] ` become checklist items, and a tearable pad
can have its page torn off. The value is plain, line-based Markdown, and the element is a form control.

The paper is presentation, so it is set entirely through CSS variables: set `--c2-notepad__grid--color` for graph
paper, `--c2-notepad__dot--color` (with `--c2-notepad__rule--color: transparent`) for a dot grid, and swap
`--c2-notepad__spiral--display` / `--c2-notepad__glue--display` for a glued legal pad. `pad` picks a ready-made
preset of those variables (notebook, legal pad, sticky note, index card); a variable set on the element
still wins over the preset.

The handwriting face is Patrick Hand (SIL Open Font License 1.1), bundled and registered with `document.fonts`
only when the writing surface uses it.

members.name: value
members.description: The page, in the notepad Markdown dialect: one line per line, `- [ ]` checklist items, `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `~~strike~~`, `==highlight==`, `<u>`, `<span data-ink>` and `<mark data-color>`.

members.name: name
members.description: Name submitted with the form.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the writing surface.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded from the host.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text written in faint pencil while the page is empty.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents editing and removes the notepad from keyboard navigation.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while allowing selection.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires some text for form validation.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Maximum number of characters of plain text; -1 means unlimited.

members.name: error
members.description: Shows the error margin and error note.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Note written in red pen when `error` is set.

members.name: toolbar
members.description: `auto` opens the formatting toolbar over a selection; `none` keeps the keyboard shortcuts and hides it.

members.name: marks
members.description: Space-separated formats the writer may apply (`bold italic underline strike ink highlight`). Pasted formatting outside the list is dropped. Empty allows all.

members.name: tearable
members.description: Adds a perforated top edge with a "Tear off" button and a stack of sheets underneath.

members.name: page
members.description: Number of the current page; it goes up by one each time a page is torn off.

members.name: pad
members.description: Kind of pad: `notebook`, `legal`, `sticky` or `index-card`. Each is a preset of the paper's CSS variables. The writer changes it through the paper picker.

members.name: paper
members.description: Ruling of the page: `lined`, `grid`, `dot` or `blank`. The writer changes it through the paper picker.

members.name: paperColor
members.description: Colour of the page and its ink: `default`, `yellow`, `green`, `blue`, `pink` or `night`. The writer changes it through the paper picker.

members.name: inks
members.description:
The inks of the toolbar: each entry a CSS colour (`var()` included), or `{ value, name }` to give its swatch a
friendly name (`{ "value": "#b91c1c", "name": "Alert" }`); without one it is called `Ink 2`. The page stores an ink
by its 1-based position in this list (`<span data-ink="2">`), so give a dark theme a list of the same length and
order and the whole page recolours. Unset, the four documented `--c2-notepad__ink-*` inks. A list you give is used
as given: its contrast on the paper is yours to choose.

members.name: highlights
members.description: The highlighters of the toolbar, as colours or `{ value, name }` entries, stored by position like `inks`. `==text==` is the first one. Unset, the three documented `--c2-notepad__highlight-*` highlighters.

members.name: paperPicker
members.description: Adds a "Paper" button to the top of the sheet, which lets the writer choose the pad, the ruling and the paper colour.

members.name: pointerFocus
members.description: Focus came from a pointer, so the keyboard focus ring stays off.

members.name: openGroup
members.description: Colour group whose flyout was opened by a click, a tap or the keyboard (hover opens it through CSS).

members.name: pickedGroup
members.description: Group whose colour was just picked by pointer: its hover flyout stays shut until the pointer leaves.

members.name: paperMenuPinned
members.description: Opened by a click, a tap or the keyboard, so it stays open when the pointer leaves.

members.name: viewportFrame
members.description: Pending frame of a scroll or resize while a popover is open.

members.name: serialized
members.description: The value the editor last produced, so writing it back (v-model) does not reset the page.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: text
members.description: The page as plain text, one line per line, without formatting or checklist markers.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the writing surface.

members.name: isDirty
members.description: Whether the writer has edited the page since the last reset.

members.name: reset
members.description: Restores the `value` attribute and clears the error state.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets or clears a custom validation message.

members.name: formatSelection
members.description:
Applies a format to the selection, or to what is typed next when nothing is selected. Bold, italic, underline
and strike toggle. For `ink` and `highlight`, pass the colour's 1-based position in `inks` / `highlights` (a
default colour's name such as `red` also works) to apply it, or `null` to remove it; with no colour the first one
is toggled. Returns whether anything was applied.

members.name: clearFormatting
members.description: Removes every format from the selection.

members.name: tearOff
members.description:
Tears the page off: fires a cancelable `page-tear` with the page's value, plays the tear (skipped under
reduced motion), clears the page and turns to the next one. Resolves to the torn value, or `null` when the
notepad is not editable or the event was cancelled. The page stays undoable with Ctrl/⌘ Z.

members.name: parsePastedText
members.description:
Pasted plain text is read as notepad Markdown. Its first and last lines join the line being written on, unless
they are checklist items, which keep their own line.

members.name: syncSelectionFromDom
members.description:
ProseMirror learns where a click put the caret from `selectionchange`, which the browser fires asynchronously. A
key pressed before it arrives (Enter, a shortcut) would run against the old selection, so read the real one first.

members.name: domSelection

type.text: { anchorNode: Node; anchorOffset: number; focusNode: Node; focusOffset: number } | null

members.description:
The caret and selection inside the shadow root. The standard way is `getComposedRanges` with this shadow root
(Chromium, WebKit, Firefox), whose `direction` tells the anchor from the focus. WebKit's `shadowRoot.getSelection()`
can lag behind a selection set from script, so it is only the fallback for browsers without composed ranges.

members.name: filterSlice
members.description: Drops the formats `marks` does not allow from pasted content.

members.name: toolbarButtons
members.description: The toolbar's own row of buttons, in roving order; the colour swatches live in their group's flyout.

members.name: openPaperMenu
members.description: The picker behaves as a hover card: the pointer opens it, a click, a tap or the keyboard pins it open.

members.name: placePaperMenu
members.description: Places the card under the Paper button, or above it when there is no room below.

members.name: stopNativeEditing
members.description: Stops the editing surface's own `input` / `beforeinput`: the element fires its own `input` with `value` up to date.

members.name: colorVars
members.description:
`--_ink-<n>`, `--_ink-<n>-night` and `--_highlight-<n>` for every colour of the lists: the marks on the page and
the swatches read them, so a new list recolours both in place, and a position the list does not have stays unset
(its marks fall back to the page's ink). On night paper an ink is lifted towards white so it stays readable.

events.name: page-tear
events.description: Fired before a page is torn off; cancel it to keep the page. Does not bubble.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the notepad loses focus after its value changed, and after a page is torn off.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired on each edit, after `value` is updated.

events.name: check-change
events.description: Fired when a checklist item is ticked or unticked. Does not bubble.

events.name: format-change
events.description: Fired when the formatting at the selection changes. Does not bubble.

events.name: paper-change
events.description: Fired when the writer picks another pad, ruling or paper colour in the paper picker. Does not bubble.
